blinding_guess.why: All ten packet elements are declared in the snapshot with consistent signatures (MatDataPlot class, its _canvas and _curves attributes and redraw(); PlotWidget class, add_topic/remove_topic/enable_timer/switch_data_plot_widget methods, and topic_edit from plot.ui via loadUi). notes: ROS 1 (groovy), pure-Python rqt GUI plugin; all packet elements are Python API symbols, so msg_type, frame, units, QoS, rate and definition_id do not apply and are null (no message definition is involved, definition_hash.py not used). Snapshot contains the whole rqt_common_plugins stack (21 package dirs); only snapshot/rqt_plot was described. PlotWidget.topic_edit has no Python assignment: it is the QLineEdit child named topic_edit in resource/plot.ui, attached to the PlotWidget instance by python_qt_binding.loadUi at plot_widget.py:59; its declares entry therefore quotes the .ui line. MatDataPlot._canvas is an instance of the nested class MatDataPlot.Canvas (FigureCanvasQTAgg subclass, mat_data_plot.py:68); MatDataPlot._curves maps curve_id to a tuple (data_x, data_y, line, range_y) (mat_data_plot.py:100). PlotWidget.enable_timer starts a QTimer with _redraw_interval = 40 ms (plot_widget.py:49, 216), i.e. a 25 Hz GUI redraw; this is not a ROS port rate, so rate_hz is left null. Topics plotted by PlotWidget are supplied at run time (command-line args, UI text, drag-and-drop, saved settings) and subscribed via rosplot.ROSData with rospy.Subscriber (rosplot.py:114), so no topic element is recorded. references is empty because the packet has no consumed element; the code does use external APIs (rqt_py_common.topic_completer.TopicCompleter, rqt_py_common.topic_helpers.is_slot_numeric, rqt_gui_py.plugin.Plugin, rosgraph.Master, rospy.Subscriber), which are not packet elements. Recovery is marked present on the reading that a backend fallback and a wait-until-published retry count as declared recovery behaviour; neither is tied to a listed element.
